description: This file provides Finnish localization strings for the Select2 jQuery plugin, version 4.0.6-rc.1. It defines messages for errors, input length validation, loading states, and selection limits, specifically translated into Finnish.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when loading results fails.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns the message when the user inputs more characters than allowed.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns the message when the user inputs fewer characters than required.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message shown when loading more results.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns the message indicating the maximum number of selections allowed.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the message when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the message when search is in progress.
